name: io.github.A1-x-Tech/mcp-yandex-merchants
title: Yandex Merchants MCP
description: MCP server for the Yandex Merchants partner API: feeds, offer prices, discounts, hide/unhide.

environmentVariables.name: YANDEX_MERCHANTS_OAUTH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Yandex OAuth token with the products:partner-api scope, obtained under the login that uploaded the feed. Treat it as a secret.

environmentVariables.name: YANDEX_MERCHANTS_MAX_RETRIES
environmentVariables.description: Retries on transient errors (429 always; 5xx/network for GET only).
